headline: Sets rules for how the federal government issues permits for certain energy facilities and land crossings at US borders.
what_it_does: This order deals with presidential permits needed to build certain facilities that cross the US border, such as energy-related facilities and land crossings like bridges or roads. It lays out how those permits are issued and which federal officials handle them. The title gives few details, so the exact steps and agencies involved are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They must follow the permit process this order sets to build facilities that cross a US international border.

who_it_affects.group: Groups building border bridges, roads, or other land crossings
who_it_affects.how: Their projects at the border fall under the permit rules described in this order.
The order sets how federal officials review and decide on these border permits.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 30, 2004; the exact effective date is not stated in the provided material.
